title: Plus Size Glitter A-Line Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size wedding guest dress combines a softly pleated skirt with an intricately beaded bodice for an elegant, polished finish. The sheer neckline and cap sleeves highlight the shoulders and upper body, while the defined waist helps create a smooth, flattering shape. A beautiful option for wedding guest dressing and other special occasions.




Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
